headline: Anthropic to watermark Claude output under EU code
body: A quiet day. Anthropic said models released after August 2 will watermark text and files, joining other big labs under the EU AI Act Transparency Code, a small step for Global Coordination. French publishers asked the competition watchdog to act on Google's AI summaries, a push against Power Concentration that slightly lifts Libertarian Utopia. Horizon Balance edged up to -0.30.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.1, from the French publishers' complaint (-0.09) and fading earlier news (-0.05). Zookeeper -0.1, from the French publishers' complaint (-0.06) and fading earlier news (-0.05).
